import hashlib,json,math,pathlib,sys

    if not condition: raise ValueError(message)

    manifest_bytes=pathlib.Path(manifest_path).read_bytes()
    manifest=json.loads(manifest_bytes)
    stop_tick,rate=manifest['stopTick'],manifest['ticksPerSecond']
    require(type(stop_tick) is int and stop_tick>0 and type(rate) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(rate) and rate>0 and manifest['stopVolumeClearTick']==stop_tick,'Invalid native stop/volume-clear timing')
    stop=stop_tick/rate
    audio=read_pcm16(wav_path)
    first,last=(round((stop-offset)*audio.sample_rate) for offset in (0.5,0.1))
    require(audio.channels==manifest['sidCount'] and 0<=first<last<=audio.frames and last/audio.sample_rate<stop,'Pre-stop release window must fit the declared audio before volume clear')

    require(all(channel['acRms']<=16 for channel in metrics['perChannel']),label+' release exceeds 16 PCM16 AC RMS before volume clear')
